name: Local Law
summary: Patrol officers equal to half the Players stop anyone visibly armed or armored and call backup if challenged.

name: Corporate Guards
summary: Low-level Corporate guards equal to the Players, in Light Armorjack with SMGs, move off trespassers.

name: Techs
summary: Techs equal to half the Players with shotguns; 1d10 decides whether they load crates, repair a City system or walk to work.

name: Private Investigator
summary: A PI with a Very Heavy Pistol and baton in Medium Armorjack; 1d10 decides whether they hassle an informant, shadow a target or question the Crew.

name: Corporates
summary: Corporates equal to the Players, in Kevlar suits with Medium Pistols; 1d10 decides whether gangers follow them, they mistake the Crew for boosters, or they call Corporate backup.

name: Locals
summary: Two young locals; 1d10 decides whether Red Chrome Legion gangers rob them or Inquisitor cultists beat them.

name: Reclaimers
summary: Reclaimers equal to the Players minus 2 with 1 chief, wiring an abandoned building into the grid; 1d10 decides whether they ignore the Crew, challenge it or cause a blackout.

name: Medias
summary: A 2-person camera and interview crew; 1d10 decides whether the story-subject spots them and a conflict starts.

name: Private Investigator

name: Trauma Team
